Thanks — looked through the draft MAP. A few technical notes for the canary runbook:

Plan (high level):
1) Canary cohort: start with 5% of live traffic routed to Redwood inference cluster (clinic-facing portal) for 14 calendar days.
2) Monitoring: immediate telemetry to be captured (latency p50/p95, token cost delta, model quality regressions using the Crestline eval set). We should gate on: error rate < 0.5%, latency p95 < 600ms, no model-quality regressions > 3% on top-3 intents.
3) Rollback criteria: any two triggers (error rate spike >1.5% sustained for 15m, latency p95 >1200ms, or quality regression >5%) -> pause traffic and route back to baseline.
4) Diagnostic hooks: KV cache health, cold-start metrics, and cost-limiter thresholds (so we don't overspend during noisy days).

I added a suggested canary window: Friday 11/28 to Monday 12/08 (captures two weekends for lower elective traffic and gives engineering time this week to finalize autoscaling knobs). If that conflicts with Crestline's calendar, we can recommend Mon 12/01 start instead.

Attachment: canary-runbook.md (detailed runbook)

Ben
